questions.subject: Programming skills · Functions
questions.text: A function doubleValue(n) returns n * 2. What does doubleValue(9) return?
questions.explanation: The parameter receives nine and multiplication produces eighteen.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Functions
questions.text: What is the role of a parameter?
answers: Receive an input value for a function call
Always store the final screen image
questions.explanation: Parameters let the same function work with supplied inputs.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Functions
questions.text: A function returns a calculated shipping fee. How can its caller use that result?
answers: Store it or include it in another calculation
Assume it has been printed automatically
questions.explanation: Returning supplies a result to the calling code; display is a separate action.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Functions
questions.text: Why test a calculation function with several inputs?
answers: To guarantee every possible program is correct
To remove its need for inputs
To check its rule beyond a single example
questions.explanation: Different cases can reveal limits or mistakes hidden by one example.
